store.tagline: Catch the falling stars, dodge the bombs — a tiny arcade test game.
store.how_it_plays: Slide your basket left and right to catch the golden stars raining from the night sky. Each star is a point. Miss a star or grab a red bomb and you lose a heart — three hearts and it's over. The longer you survive, the faster the sky falls.

features.title: One-file arcade
features.body: A single HTML canvas game — no assets, no dependencies, instant to load.

features.title: Keyboard or pointer
features.body: Play with arrow keys, A/D, or by dragging with the mouse or a finger.

features.title: Rising difficulty
features.body: The fall speed and bomb rate climb the longer you last, so every run is tense.

features.title: Local best score
features.body: Your best catch is saved on the device and shown in the HUD.

includes: YouTeacher Activator — one app licenses every game on your USB

setup.title: Install
setup.body: Run the installer for your platform.

setup.title: Activate
setup.body: License it with the YouTeacher Activator on your USB.

setup.title: Play
setup.body: Launch Star Catch and start catching stars.
